title: Random Item Timer By Divvers
description: Every 30 seconds every player gains a random item!
body:
Random Item Challenge

Looking for a way to spice up your next survival world or multiplayer server? This mod adds a simple but chaotic twist to the game: every 30 seconds, every single player online is given a completely unique, randomized item.

One player might get a diamond block, while another gets a piece of dirt or a random tool. It completely changes how you play, forcing you to adapt to whatever the game throws into your inventory.
Features

Total Chaos: Every player gets a different item at the exact same time—no shared drops!

Completely Silent: No messy chat spam popping up every 30 seconds. 
Items just appeardirectly in your inventory (or drop at your feet if your inventory is full).

Multiplayer Ready: Works perfectly in singleplayer worlds or on servers with your friends (and essential mod too).
